regimen_profiles.regimen_role: First-line systemic treatment for adults with advanced or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.
regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: Tremelimumab blocks CTLA-4 to enhance T-cell priming. Durvalumab blocks PD-L1 to support antitumour T-cell activity. Immune activation may also inflame healthy organs.
regimen_profiles.treatment_setting: First-line systemic treatment for adults with advanced or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Tremelimumab blocks CTLA-4 to enhance T-cell priming. Durvalumab blocks PD-L1 to support antitumour T-cell activity. Immune activation may also inflame healthy organs.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: Cycle 1 only: tremelimumab 300 mg IV once, followed 60–120 minutes after completion by durvalumab 1,500 mg IV. Cycle 2 onwards: durvalumab alone on day 1 every 28 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Each infusion lasts 60 minutes.
key_points: The tremelimumab dose is given once. At ≤40 kg use 4 mg/kg for tremelimumab. At ≤30 kg use 20 mg/kg for durvalumab.
For hepatic toxicity, select the correct branch from both baseline enzymes; pair each current value with its own baseline. Address alternative causes of bilirubin elevation.
Grade 3 colitis permanently discontinues tremelimumab where applicable. Hold durvalumab; consider consultant-led resumption once the event resolves. Grade 4 permanently stops treatment.
regimen_profiles.review_status: Source-reconciled feasibility build; independent oncology and pharmacy review pending.

treatment_rationale.summary: Tremelimumab blocks CTLA-4 to enhance T-cell priming. Durvalumab blocks PD-L1 to support antitumour T-cell activity. Immune activation may also inflame healthy organs.
factors: BCLC B or C, Child–Pugh A or B7 and ECOG 0–2. Confirm adequate organ and marrow function.
alternatives: Discuss other eligible Irish first-line treatments, trials and supportive care with the multidisciplinary team.
limitations: HIMALAYA mainly enrolled people with Child–Pugh A liver function and ECOG 0–1. Generalisability to Child–Pugh B7 or ECOG 2 is limited.

patient_selection.treatment_intent: Improve disease control and survival in advanced HCC.
disease_and_biomarker_context: First-line systemic treatment for adults with advanced or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.

eligibility_orientation.setting: First-line systemic treatment for adults with advanced or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.
review: BCLC B or C, Child–Pugh A or B7 and ECOG 0–2. Confirm adequate organ and marrow function.

exclusion_orientation: Hypersensitivity to either medicine or an excipient; pregnancy; breastfeeding. Refer to NCCP guidance on prior anti-PD-1 / anti-PD-L1 treatment.
important_cautions: Active or prior autoimmune disease, systemic immunosuppression above 10 mg/day prednisolone equivalent, or previous checkpoint treatment require review.

premedication_and_prophylaxis: Routine premedication is usually unnecessary. Follow the treating unit’s supportive plan.
counselling: Carry the immunotherapy alert card. New cough, breathlessness, diarrhoea, jaundice, severe fatigue or weakness can require urgent assessment during or after treatment.

baseline: Full blood count, kidney and liver profile, blood glucose and thyroid function before the first dose and before each cycle.
Baseline hepatitis B surface antigen and core antibody, and hepatitis C testing. Record individual pretreatment ALT and AST for the hepatitis pathway.
before_each_cycle: Full blood count, kidney and liver profile, blood glucose and thyroid function before the first dose and before each cycle.

cells: Blood count, renal/liver profile, glucose, TFTs, HBV and HCV screening.
Full blood count, renal/liver tests, glucose and thyroid.
Cortisol and other investigations as clinically indicated.

Pneumonitis, immune nephritis, myocarditis, endocrinopathies, neurological and muscle events; apply the syndrome-specific source rules.

administration.cycle_and_sequence: Cycle 1 only: tremelimumab 300 mg IV once, followed 60–120 minutes after completion by durvalumab 1,500 mg IV. Cycle 2 onwards: durvalumab alone on day 1 every 28 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Each infusion lasts 60 minutes.
route_and_duration: IV; each drug is infused over 60 minutes. See NCCP for inline filter, dilution and concentration.
practical_workflow: The tremelimumab dose is given once. At ≤40 kg use 4 mg/kg for tremelimumab. At ≤30 kg use 20 mg/kg for durvalumab.

Table 1 covers baseline organ impairment. For either medicine, no dose adjustment is needed at creatinine clearance ≥30 mL/min. At <30 mL/min or during haemodialysis no adjustment is expected. For liver impairment no adjustment is needed with mild to moderate impairment for tremelimumab or mild impairment for durvalumab. No adjustment is expected with severe impairment for tremelimumab or moderate to severe impairment for durvalumab. Confirm suitability with the oncology team.

evidence_at_a_glance.comparison: STRIDE versus sorafenib; the study also included a separate durvalumab monotherapy arm.
evidence_at_a_glance.applicability: First-line systemic treatment for adults with advanced or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma.

endpoints.result_text: 16.43 months with STRIDE vs 13.77 months with sorafenib; hazard ratio 0.78 (96.02% CI 0.65–0.93).
endpoints.interpretation: Overall survival was longer with STRIDE in the randomised first-line comparison.
limitations: HIMALAYA mainly enrolled people with Child–Pugh A liver function and ECOG 0–1. Generalisability to Child–Pugh B7 or ECOG 2 is limited.
